actions.accessHint: Issues a new invitation for the administrator and shows the three links to hand over. No effect on an account that is already activated, other than giving the back-office address again.
actions.noAdmin: This salon has no administrator account to re-invite.
actions.suspendHint: Suspending closes the storefront, the booking journey and back-office sign-in, and cuts open sessions. Reversible.
actions.suspendedHint: The salon is suspended: its storefront and its back office answer “not found”.
actions.reasonRequired: State the reason — it is kept in the salon’s history.
actions.reasonHint: Kept in the salon’s history, visible to the other operators.
actions.noteHint: Visible to the operators only. No client data.
actions.notePlaceholder: E.g. manager called back, follow-up planned for Monday.

access.invitationHint: To send to the manager: they choose their password there and land in their back office. Valid for {expiry}, once only.
access.adminHint: The sign-in address of the manager and their team, once the account is activated.
access.bookingHint: The public link the salon shares with its clients.

create.title: Open a salon
create.name: Salon name
create.slugHint: Lower case, digits and hyphens. It appears in every link: /maison-lotus/reservation.
create.timezoneHint: Every slot of the salon is shown in this time zone.
create.languageHint: The language its storefront, its back office and its emails open in. The salon can change it in its settings.
create.ownerHint: They become the salon administrator: they manage the services, the hours, the team and the settings. No email is sent automatically — you hand them the activation link.
create.openedBody: An administrator account has been created for {firstName} {lastName} ({email}). Send them the activation link below: they will choose their password there, then enter their services and their hours and invite their team.
